description: This file defines a React hook 'useHistory' that provides memoized access to history-related state and actions, as well as exporting a context provider 'HistoryProvider'. It is part of a frontend web application related to a chess learner tool.

methods.name: useHistory()
methods.description: A React hook that returns memoized selectors for history state and bound actions, intended for use within <HistoryProvider>.
